sentence_quote: In the absence of pre-sentence custody I would have sentenced you to a period of imprisonment for nine years. Crediting you with two years and six months custody, I now impose a sentence upon you today of six years and six months.

sentence_quote: Therefore, Mr. Blaney is sentenced to six months' incarceration.
systemic_quote: So I have come to the view that systemic and background factors bear on Mr. Blaney's moral culpability, and I should take that into account.

sentence_quote: Accordingly, we would grant leave to appeal and vary the four-year sentence imposed on the Ancaster offences by making it concurrent with the global sentence of seven years imposed on the Brantford offences.
note: Four years now concurrent with earlier seven-year sentence rather than consecutive.
